title: Tracking Configuration Relocation
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Boolean Turing machine, let $x,y$ be Boolean words, and choose a source configuration $c$ on input $y$, a Boolean tag $b$, a movement-count family $n$, a record word, and natural numbers $T,t$. Relocating the canonical tracking configuration determined by $c,b,n$ into the recorder's tracking slots, using the recorder configuration's remaining tapes and head positions, gives exactly the recorder configuration in its tracking phase.
hypotheses_covered: A finite-state Boolean Turing machine M
A source configuration c on input y
replaced: For every source configuration, tag, movement counts, record, clock budget, and logical time, relocating the canonical tracking seam into the recorder's tapes, retaining the record and clock slots from the recorder configuration itself, yields exactly the recorder configuration in the counter-update phase.
